title: Lychee Light Club
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: An ero-guro horror based on a stage play. Nine middle-school boys in a sooty factory town form the Light Club and build Lychee, a fruit-powered thinking machine, to abduct beautiful girls; under the paranoid, fascist-styled leader Zera the club descends into murder and betrayal, while Lychee grows more human through a captive girl, Kanon (Kodansha blurb; Wikipedia; The Comics Journal).
life_message: Cult-like loyalty, contempt for adulthood and the worship of power and beauty end in mutual destruction.

content.note: Graphic gore, murder and dismemberment (TCJ; AniList Gore 83%; MU Blood and Gore, Murder/s).
Sadism, psychopathy and kidnapping (MU tags; TCJ).
Rape and sodomy depicted, ero-guro emphasis (TCJ; AniList Rape 53%; MU Rape, Masturbation). Characters are middle schoolers.
Paranoia, psychopathy and fear of puberty (TCJ; MU Psychopath/s).
Kidnapping girls and cultic obedience by children (Wikipedia; MU Kidnapping, Devoted Followers).

dominant: Satire of fascism and youth cults; ero-guro cruelty; the machine that learns humanity

frames.aligns: Shows idolatry of power and beauty destroying its worshippers.
frames.concerns: Sexual violence and gore made aesthetic; Christian girl Kanon objectified.

frames.aligns: Critique of fascism and toxic male bonding.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Zera obsessed with betrayal; loyalty enforced by death (TCJ).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Dictator leader and devoted followers (MU Devoted Followers).

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Ritual worship of Kanon beside a 'thinking machine' (TCJ).

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Perverse aestheticism within a survival-paranoid group (blurb).

folkways.japan: Ero-guro (erotic grotesque) art and the angura underground theatre the story comes from are Japanese avant-garde traditions, described here as context.

delivery.evidence: TCJ calls the work largely amoral satire but faults a late, heavy-handed moral ending.

personified.ideology: Fascist dictatorship and cult of youth
A machine learning humanity and art

delivery.note: The fascist ideal is satirized through its own adherents' grotesque cheerfulness, ending with an explicit moral turn.

winners_losers: Nearly everyone loses; the club destroys itself. Sympathy goes to Lychee and the captive girl rather than to the club's ideology.
